mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals active monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by >0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates labor market deterioration that triggers equity risk-off behavior, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate declines signal aggressive monetary tightening to cool a strong labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (FEDFUNDS change * UNRATE change) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts above 1-year average signal sustained consumer demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST > 1-year MA.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls growth above 1-year average signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS growth > 1-year average.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 5.0% (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) prompts aggressive monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts and industrial production indicate robust aggregate demand and supply chain resilience, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (HOUST change * INDPRO change) has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO below 1-year moving average), weak industrial production signals persistent supply shocks that pressure corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In supply-constrained regimes, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).
